About me

Product Designer25 years old, Londrina, PR, Brazil. Working remotely with clients in Brazil and abroad.

I'm a Brazilian product designer who has worked across many areas of design. I started as a graphic designer and went deep into UX/UI and product design, first at an events platform and then designing web and mobile products for international clients at Codeleap. I keep files organized, teams aligned and handoffs precise, and I'm always open to learning something new.
